purpose: Operator-verified final scores that outrank every result donor and the shared settled overlay. Used by audit_recent_picks and auto_tickets so a single bad donor row (wrong score or wrong spelling) can never hold a pick as an alias-outcome conflict. These rows never affect source voting, picks, prices, certification, or notifications.
